description: This donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” visually represents the distribution of 38 stimuli across six distinct categories, each labeled with its count out of 38. The largest segment is “External News Article (15/38),” shown as a large dark green slice. Following this in descending order are “Draft/Other (9/38)” in red, “Email (5/38)” in dark red, “Press Release (4/38)” in yellow, “Interview (2/38)” in purple, and “Intra-agency news article (1/38)” in a very small orange slice. The chart includes a central white circle with the title and no legend, with each category label positioned externally near its corresponding slice. The segments appear arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the bottom left and moving clockwise.
